item.title: Project Show-Off Day
item.description:
Project Show-Off Day

Do you have a project you've been wanting to show off? Or are you looking for inspiration?

Come to our personal project show-off day! Here, you can show off a computer-science related project (code, software, hardware, etc.) to others. You can just show your project, and feedback is available from attendees if desired.

Our faculty advisor should be attending, and as a CIDS professor, they will be able to provide great feedback.

How does it work?

Show off a CIDS-related project you created. This can be something you created on your own time, or part of a class/internship. All that matters is that you made it!

Each person will have up to 15-20 minutes to present their project. You can create a formal presentation if you'd like, but you just need to cover general talking points for your project or run through it. Try to cover high-level concepts of your project, not low-level concepts (e.g. playing through a game, not showing the code).

Don't worry if your project is small or short! If you can explain your whole project in 1-2 minutes, that's fine!

If you're presenting software/something digital, please bring a laptop with the project on it that contains a functional HDMI port. If you're unable to do this, please contact an officer ASAP so we can figure out an alternative solution.

 

We hope to see you there!

From Monday, April 6, 2026 4:30 PM to 6:30 PM CDT at South Hall 21.

item.title: ACM LAN Party
item.description:
ACM LAN Party

For our ACM end-of-semester celebration, experience a classic LAN party like it's 1999. No wireless, no matchmaking, just twisted pairs, switches, and local IPs! We will be having pizza and soda.

For our games we will be playing some contemporary games such as Quake 3 Arena, as well as Minecraft and whatever else we can think of!

Come early, come late, or don't! Stay as long as you like!

 

Requirements:

- Laptop with USB A, USB C, or an Ethernet port. (We will have mice, don't worry about bringing your own)

From Monday, April 27, 2026 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM CDT at South Hall 21.
